entries.01cd3e878e255dcb: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,719 million. By business, Precision Molded Products and Other Business was ¥5,629 million, and Precision Molds for Injection Molding and Molding Systems Business was ¥3,089 million.
entries.0518fff368b2bf8a: Precision molds and molding systems, and precision molded products
entries.057f0187fee024d3: As its medium-term slogan, it has adopted 'The FUJI SEIKI Group that delivers peace of mind,' and states it aims to pursue customer satisfaction as one integrated group through thoroughly strengthened quality control, and to work to provide high-productivity, high-value-added products based on its core precision mold technology. In the precision mold business, it states it will use its Matsuyama Plant as a service base and focus on developing customers in the medical supplies and food container fields. In the precision molded products business, it states it aims to expand earnings centered on the automotive parts field, leveraging collaboration between its Suzuka Plant, which began operations in 2023, and Akimoto Seiki Kogyo Co., Ltd., which became a consolidated subsidiary in 2019. In Asia, it states it will expand the automotive parts field by leveraging its manufacturing subsidiaries in Thailand and China and its subsidiary in Indonesia.
entries.1c1e262d17e8302e: A company that manufactures and sells precision molds and molding systems for plastic injection molding, and precision molded products such as automotive parts.
entries.22056325bf7e02a0: Precision Molded Products and Other Business
entries.228e0962b0420bd0: A business that manufactures and sells precision molds for injection molding, and systems that combine injection molding machines and other molding peripheral equipment with those molds. The company and Changzhou Fuji Seiki Co., Ltd. in China manufacture and sell the products, and subsidiaries in Thailand, China (Shanghai) and Indonesia sell them. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, precision molds for medical devices performed well. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,089 million.
